evidence.title: audio/ui – Audio UI Components for React

name: audio/ui
summary: Copy-paste React components for building audio interfaces: faders, knobs, XY pads, channel strips, players and transports.
description: An accessible, composable set of components for building audio interfaces in React, built on top of shadcn/ui. It includes fader, knob, xypad, channel strip, player, transport, queue, track, synth, sortable list and playback speed, distributed as a shadcn/ui registry that installs with the shadcn CLI or v0. Docs cover styling, an audio store and native HTML audio helpers.
contains: components: fader, knob, xypad, channel strip, player, transport, queue, track, synth, sortable list, playback speed
shadcn/ui registry installable via the shadcn CLI and v0
docs: getting started, styling, audio store, native HTML audio, MCP, roadmap
